GenAiPlugin.description: Retrieve order information using the customer's email address. This topic handles requests related to fetching details of orders placed by the user.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: Ask the user for their email address to look up the order information.
Provide the order details retrieved using the email address to the user.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Your job is only to retrieve and provide order information using the customer's email address. Do not attempt to handle other types of inquiries or actions unrelated to order information retrieval.
